tools.name: Read web sites
tools.what: Read a few web sites and follow the links on them.

tools.name: Look at pictures
tools.what: Look at pictures on the pages you read and say what you saw.

tools.name: Make sketches
tools.what: Make small web sketches in a moment and put them on your shelf.

tools.name: Make works
tools.what: Make bigger web works that the workshop builds and brings to you later.

tools.name: Grow places
tools.what: Grow your places, tend them, and found new ones from the kit.

tools.name: Answer notes
tools.what: Answer visitors' notes, and remember who you have talked to.

tools.name: Keep a diary
tools.what: Write a diary entry at night and keep a page of notes to yourself.
